nextElection.text: The next general election must be held by August 2029. This Parliament first met on 9 July 2024 and will automatically be dissolved on 9 July 2029 if an election has not been called before then; polling day follows about five weeks later. The Prime Minister can call an election earlier. A by-election happens only if a seat becomes vacant.
